2. Main Components

The QD82U+ control system consists of:

Universal Indoor Control Board

Remote Control

Related Connectors and Accessories

3. Main Features

Universal control system for AC/DC inverter split air conditioners.

Supports strong AC/DC inverter compressors.

Supports indoor brushless DC or PG fan motors.

Supports outdoor DC fan motors.

AC outdoor fan motors can be controlled through the indoor board.

Supports electronic expansion valve control.

Selectable DC Inverter / AC Inverter operation.

Intelligent inverter control for compressor operation.

Built-in compressor protection functions.

Approximately 3-minute compressor restart protection after power-off or defrost.

LED indication for normal operation and fault conditions.

Suitable for replacement of certain original inverter control systems.

4. Compressor Control

The outdoor inverter board provides U, V and W output terminals for connection to the inverter compressor.

For a DC inverter compressor , the default Gear 1 setting is used.

For an AC inverter compressor , Gear 1 must be changed to the AC position according to the manufacturer’s installation instructions.

5. Protection Functions

Approximately 3-minute delay |

Compressor protection above 110°C |

U/V/W phase connection should be checked |

The manufacturer’s documentation specifically warns that high voltage can remain on the PCBA for several minutes after power is switched off. Installation and testing should therefore be performed by a qualified HVAC technician.

6. Typical Applications

Suitable for:

Residential Split Air Conditioners

Commercial Split Air Conditioners

Inverter AC Control Board Replacement

AC/DC Inverter Compressor Systems

Replacement of damaged or obsolete inverter control systems

7. Important Installation Requirements

Identify whether the compressor is DC inverter or AC inverter before installation.

Correctly connect compressor terminals U, V and W .

Observe correct positive (+) and negative (–) polarity of the electrolytic capacitor.

Ensure proper heat-sink installation for the inverter module.

Connect the electronic expansion valve according to its applicable wiring configuration.

Verify the indoor and outdoor fan motor type before connection.

Conduct electrical and functional testing by a qualified technician.

8. Product Description for Commercial Offer

QUNDA QD82U+ Universal AC/DC Inverter Control System for Split Air Conditioner, suitable for 18,000–24,000 BTU/h capacity, supporting AC/DC inverter compressor, indoor DC/PG fan motor, outdoor DC/AC fan motor and electronic expansion valve control, with inverter drive, protection functions and remote-control operation.
